classification.notes: BORDERLINE easy at 2. Effort: herb/lettuce prep (1); stirring the rice and turkey (1); one main with raw wraps, rice powder is a toasting step in the same pan (0); dry-toast and sauté technique (0); one skillet + grinder (0). Sum 2 = easy. Complexity: 12 countable ingredients (oil, water excluded) -> 1; fish sauce (1 widely available specialty) -> 1; one lime-fish-sauce dressing profile (0); mainstream sourcing (0). Sum 2 = standard. Matches WAVE proposal.
